G06F

Methodology: Patent filings were counted per year (filing year extracted from filing_date) for each CPC technology area rolled up to level 5 (subclass) of the CPC hierarchy, as defined in the CPCDefinition_database (level = 5, e.g., G06F). Each patent was counted once per distinct subclass. An exponential moving average of yearly filing counts was computed per subclass with smoothing factor alpha = 0.2 (EMA_t = 0.2 * count_t + 0.8 * EMA_{t-1}, over a complete zero-filled year grid 1877-2024; results verified robust to EMA initialization variants). For each year, the level-5 CPC area with the highest EMA was identified; the area whose best (top-EMA) year is 2022 is G06F (Electric digital data processing), with EMA_2022 = 1106.5, ahead of Y02E (868.1) and Y02P (634.6).
